schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group non-major dev tooling updates into a single PR
Leaflet is bundled into dist/: updates should lead to a patch release
Vite produces dist/: updates should lead to a patch release
Node.js versions are tracked in .nvmrc, .tool-versions and the release workflow: update them together
The engines field documents the minimum supported versions and is maintained manually
GitHub Actions are referenced by major tag only, so every update is a major: bundle them into one PR
